<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

The project's CI on GitHub Actions, for any kind of app: go vet, the tests (the runner has Docker, for testcontainers), the build, and a check that the generated code is what the model generates (esquadro gen -check, with the esquadro version of the lockfile). With docker, it builds the image and, on tags v*, publishes it to GitHub's container registry (ghcr.io/&lt;owner>/&lt;repo>).

```esquadro
blueprint github_actions
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [docker](../docker/) when the app uses them.
